thought.text: Let me try restoring from older commit with working dist:

reasoning_content: We need a different approach. Let me check for an old backup or use a very restricted subset. Let me try to restore from git an older version and work more carefully from there.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Find last working commit with dist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log --all --oneline | head -20")
print("Commits:", stdout.read().decode())

# Try checking out to older commit
print("\n--- Trying main ---")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout main 2>&1 | tail -3")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check if there's dist there
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())

# If not, try old tag
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git tag | head -5")
print("\nTags:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
